generation.style: premium medieval-fantasy game icon, evolved low-poly forms with restrained hand-painted texture, crisp dark umber edge separation, tactile materials, readable silhouette
generation.composition: one centered object in a square canvas, orthographic-like three-quarter view, balanced visual weight, generous transparent margin, readable at 24 pixels
generation.lighting: warm key light from the upper left, subtle cool fill from the lower right, controlled highlights, no cast shadow outside the object
generation.palette: aged parchment gold, basalt charcoal, muted iron and one resource-specific accent
generation.constraints: genuinely transparent background; exactly one icon subject; no frame, badge, ground plane, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark or cropped edges
generation.avoid: photorealism, glossy mobile-game plastic, noisy particles, thin detached details, muddy silhouette, excessive bloom
